1) Background / Context

The project aims to develop Diaspora, an open-source, decentralized social network designed to prioritize user privacy and data security. Unlike centralized platforms, Diaspora operates through independently run servers, known as "pods," distributed worldwide. This structure allows users to maintain control over their data, select a pod for registration, and interact seamlessly with the global Diaspora community.

2) Objectives

- Enable users to control their data and privacy.
- Facilitate seamless interactions within the Diaspora network.
- Support pseudonymous profiles for user freedom.
- Provide a customizable and open-source platform.

3) Stakeholders & Users

- Users: Individuals seeking privacy and control over their social networking experience.
- Administrators: People or entities running independent pods.
- Developers: Contributors to the open-source project.

4) Functional Descriptions

- Registration & Identity Management: Users register on a chosen pod and may use pseudonyms.
- Data Privacy Control: Users manage who can view their content using "Aspects."
- Communication & Interaction: Users can engage with others globally regardless of pod while maintaining privacy.
- Content Creation & Sharing: Users can post, share, and manage content, with features like comments, mentions, and tags.
- Data Portability: Support for account migration between pods.
- Moderation & Preferences: Functionality for blocking, reporting content, and managing user preferences.

5) Non-Functional Descriptions

- Security: Ensure data integrity and secure authentication processes.
- Scalability: Support a growing number of pods and users without compromising performance.
- Flexibility: Allow users to customize their experience and developers to contribute enhancements.
- Reliability: Maintain high availability of services across distributed pods.

-- Schema for database: schemabench_0044
CREATE TABLE `pods` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `url` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `name` (`name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `pod_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password` char(60) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `pod_id` (`pod_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `users_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`pod_id`) REFERENCES `pods` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `aspects` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `aspects_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `content` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `pod_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `pod_id` (`pod_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `content_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `content_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`pod_id`) REFERENCES `pods` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `comments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `content_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `comment` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `content_id` (`content_id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `comments_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`content_id`) REFERENCES `content` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `comments_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `mentions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `content_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `content_id` (`content_id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `mentions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`content_id`) REFERENCES `content` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `mentions_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `tags` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `content_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `tag` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `content_id` (`content_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tags_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`content_id`) REFERENCES `content` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `blocks` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `blocked_user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `blocked_user_id` (`blocked_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `blocks_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `blocks_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`blocked_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `reports` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `content_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `reason` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `content_id` (`content_id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `reports_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`content_id`) REFERENCES `content` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `reports_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `migrations` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `pod_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `pod_id` (`pod_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `migrations_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `migrations_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`pod_id`) REFERENCES `pods` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
